name: 55024 · Farmington, MN
findings: ZIP 55024 (Farmington) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55024 (Farmington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
